Parent epic: https://github.com/stevehill1981/198x/issues/110

## Scope and completion evidence
Pilot historically grounded era boundaries on Spectrum and Amiga with original sources and representative games. Distinguish possible, documented, typical and later-discovered techniques. Select one appropriately bounded game, establish era-specific gameplay, controls, art, audio, usability and reliability criteria, and evaluate gaps. Do not treat review scores or historical impressions as proof of commercial equivalence.

## Done when
- Results and source/version/environment identities are recorded, with passed/failed/skipped/unknown distinguished.
- Findings are filed as specific follow-up issues or linked to existing ones; no duplicate implementation plan.
- Reviewed findings, limits and next bounded step are linked from this issue.

Maintain existing product architecture and avoid broad rewrites.
title: [Education] Research machine-specific development eras and benchmark a capstone game
